chunks: Has the story of Moses come to you
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the question 'Has the story of Moses come to you?' in Surah An-Naziat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as a rhetorical introduction to Surah An-Naziat, emphasizing the continuity of divine revelation through the story of Musa (AS) as a paradigm for the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). The narrative underscores the theme of *Tawhid* and the eventual triumph of the faithful over tyrannical powers, resonating with the concept of *Ghaybah* and the ultimate victory of Imam al-Mahdi (AJ). This connection reinforces the didactic purpose of recounting past prophets to guide the contemporary community through trials.
